crossRefs.note: Then it seemed good to the apostles and the elders, with the whole assembly, to choose men out of their company, and…

people.name: Joseph
people.line: Candidate to replace Judas as apostle

people.name: Matthias
people.line: Apostle chosen to replace Judas Iscariot.

translations.web: They put forward two, Joseph called Barsabbas, who was also called Justus, and Matthias.
translations.bsb: So they proposed two men: Joseph called Barsabbas (also known as Justus) and Matthias.
translations.kjv: And they appointed two, Joseph called Barsabas, who was surnamed Justus, and Matthias.
translations.asv: And they put forward two, Joseph called Barsabbas, who was surnamed Justus, and Matthias.
